name: Ivory Comb
lore: Someone kept themselves tidy right up until the end.
subject: A single ancient ivory grooming comb, wide horizontal gently arched spine, ten thick slightly uneven teeth pointing downward. A few teeth chipped short. Warm aged bone, charcoal dirt in shallow carved grooves, a thin worn antique gold repair band at one end. Three-quarter near-frontal view, melancholy humble personal possession. No hair, no skull, no extra objects.

name: Wyrm Heart
lore: It still beats. It expects something of you.
subject: One fantastical preserved dragon heart, compact anatomical heart shape with two thick vessel stumps on top. Deep muted burgundy leathery muscle merging into charcoal-black reptile scales around its lower half. Subtle warm ember-orange fissure across its central lobe implies a stubborn heartbeat. Old, heavy, magical specimen, no dripping blood, no gore spray, no pedestal, no jewelry or cage. Bold pearlike asymmetrical organic silhouette.
